item.title: Vans’ Wonderfully Destroyed Skate Shoe Is *Another* Chanel Bag for Your Feet
item.description: Vans is back with more "Chanel" skate shoes. This time, the Premium Authentic 44 gets a makeover inspired by another luxury Chanel bag.

item.title: Nike’s Vomero-Coded Air Max Is Pure Heat (& Lava)
item.description: Nike's Air Max Moto 2K sneaker releases in "Team Crimson/Hot Lava," resulting in one of the model's hottest colorways yet. Literally.

item.title: Vans' Cleanest Skate Shoe Comes Pre-Scuffed
item.description: Vans' Utility Wash Authentic 44 sneaker gets down & dirty while still looking laundromat fresh.

item.title: You Can Wear Birkenstocks To Your Wedding Now (EXCLUSIVE)
item.description: Danielle Frankel's Birkenstock sandals are an example of collaborative shoes done right. These bridal Birk clogs & shoes are handcrafted & priced like gowns.

item.title: Even on the Other Side of the World, adidas’ Flat Sneakers Are Winning
item.description: Thanks to Australian sneaker boutique UP THERE, Melbourne joins the adidas City Series introducing another flat-soled banged to the brand's selection.

item.title: Don't Sleep on Nike's Rest-Focused Clog
item.description: Nike's super chic ReactX Rejuven8 clog is just as sleek as it is comfortable. No laces? No problem.

item.title: adidas' Definitive Dad Shoe Does Blue With Burgundy, Beautifully
item.description: The ultimate dad shoe from the house of adidas, the Adistar Control 5, is a bulky, boldly colored sneaker that skillfully merges nostalgia with performance.

item.title: Wales Bonner’s Knits Are Made in the World’s Oldest Operating Factory. We Got a Look Inside
item.description: The days of John Smedley Making knitwear for high fashion’s big fish were thought to be over. Then came Wales Bonner.

item.title: It’s So Much More Than a Beaten-up Hiking Boot
item.description: Guidi and nonnative’s sturdy suede hiking boots aren't just heavily distressed hikers, they're the result of a painstaking artisanal process.

item.title: VANSZA Goes Off The Wall For PFW
item.description: Taking over the streets of Paris over two days, Vans and SZA ushered in the iconic skate shoe brand's latest trailblazing era.
